description: This test checks that a user can successfully download the OpenAPI specification file for integration into their project.
steps: Open the API Documentation page at https://dev.roost.ai/docs/api.
Verify that the browser prompts for file download confirmation.
Confirm the file download and verify the file is saved to the default downloads directory.
Open the downloaded file and validate its contents against the expected OpenAPI specification format.
expected_results: The 'Download OpenAPI Specification' button is visible and clickable.
The browser's file download prompt is triggered.
The OpenAPI specification file is downloaded and saved successfully.
The contents of the downloaded file are valid and match the OpenAPI format.
edge_cases: The 'Download OpenAPI Specification' button is disabled or missing.
The file fails to download due to a server error.
The downloaded file is corrupted or incomplete.
The browser blocks the file download due to security settings.
The OpenAPI specification file is outdated or does not match the current API.
data_requirements: A valid URL for the 'Download OpenAPI Specification' button.
A server hosting the OpenAPI specification file.
Expected contents of the OpenAPI specification file.
Disk space available for file storage.
dependencies: The 'Download OpenAPI Specification' button must be functional.
The server hosting the OpenAPI specification file must be available.
The user must have browser permissions to download files.
The OpenAPI specification file must be correctly formatted.
The browser must support file downloads.
api_interactions: No direct API interactions are required.
performance_metrics: Time taken to initiate the file download.
Download speed for the OpenAPI specification file.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Download OpenAPI Specification' button is accessible via keyboard.
Verify that the button has a clear and descriptive label for screen readers.
Check that the file download process is indicated to the user.
